description: Source-to-distribution mapping of the Django Standalone Plugin. Canonical content is owned by the Django Agentic Engineering main repository; this distribution is a derived copy.
hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over LF-normalised content (equals the git blob content of the source file).

adaptations.reason: Frontmatter comment named the main repository's generator (python -m plugin_packaging build), which does not exist in the standalone distribution. The `skills:` line itself is unchanged.
Agents said the Python harness preloads their skills and rules; in the standalone plugin Claude Code does (agent frontmatter `skills:`).
Destructive database commands need approval through Claude Code's permission prompt here, not through the harness's approval service.
Orchestrator: generator references and the 'drives the harness' sentence. Routing policy content, categories, limits, delegation allowlist and procedure are unchanged.
Rules referred to the harness's approval service and secret-pattern configuration; the standalone equivalents are the user's approval prompt and hooks/security-policy.json.

orchestration-policy.yaml: comments only. Described the two adapters (generator and harness engine); now describes the standalone use. Parsed YAML content is identical to the source (checked at build time).
Guard: docstring and error message named the main repository's generator. Logic is unchanged.
security-policy.json: only the `_generated` provenance block changed (it named the main repository's generator and sources). All rules, paths, modes, tools and delegation data are identical.
Three relative links that are already dead in the canonical source (they name files that do not exist) now point at the existing files that hold that content. Link targets only; no prose changed.
templates/README.md: removed the harness runtime prompt template section (agent-task.prompt.md is not distributed) and harness wording. The output-template conventions are unchanged.
references/README.md: removed the harness-run paragraph and the Phase 3E labels.

Version 2.0.0: the plugin ships no slash commands. Approval gates that lived in the commands moved into the specialist agents (## Approval gate); harness vocabulary (AgentTask, AgentResult, output directory, dae.output_content) and command names were removed from agents, templates and the orchestration policy; the orchestrator now passes approvals through. Responsibilities, tools, write modes, skills and guard policy are unchanged.
/orchestrate: removed the execution-mode resolver and the Harness mode section (they call harness_bootstrap, which is not part of this distribution). The standalone Agent path is unchanged.

Rules gained `user-invocable: false` frontmatter so Claude Code does not list the twelve engineering standards as slash commands; they stay registered skills so agents can preload them. Body text unchanged.
Knowledge skills carry `user-invocable: false` so Claude Code lists only the ten commands; agents still preload them and models can still invoke them.

copilot_adapter.note: Canonical sources are the Claude Code files; Copilot files are derived and verified by --check. Intentional platform differences: frontmatter fields, tool aliases, skill-preload list, path tokens, no hook port (docs/copilot.md).
